text.p: Lehman Brothers, the global investment bank, said on Tuesday it has upgraded its ratings for Taiwan's Advanced Semiconductor Engineering Inc and ASE Test to "buy" from "outperform."
Lehman said in a statement it expects ASE and ASE Test to register annual earnings growth rates of 30 percent and 35 percent, respectively, over the next three to five years.

Lehman predicts strong growth for the two firms on the back of increased outsourcing of the assembly and testing of semiconductor devices by the companies which design and fabricate them, the statement said.
ASE Test, the first Taiwanese firm directly listed in the Nasdaq National Market and an integrated-circuit testing firm, is 79.6 percent owned by Taiwan's integrated-circuit packaging firm ASE.
Richard Wei, Lehman analyst, believes that both the packaging and testing markets have tremendous growth potential.

"We believe that the packaging market available to packaging service providers has a compound annual growth of 19 to 26 percent for the next three years, and that the testing market should be higher, at 32 to 55 percent because the market is smaller," Wei said. -- Taipei Newsroom (5080815)
